title: Turn back
author: Swatilekha Roy
text:
Let them go who never came
Who never stood by the river`s shore alone
Holding hands in silence
The traveller on the journey`s path
Let them mingle in the bustling crowd
Let them see the world through others` eyes.
Let come close when alone and berefeet
Take them to the river`s shore,
And show the path to turn back
